cells.gaps: No fact gives a share or count of centres registering events in the LGEC: every figure (77% of 629 in September 2026, 471 and 437 of 629 earlier) is centres digitised, deployed or covered, and SEN-015 itself says equipped centres are not the same as centres entering data. Deaths are held in the system (SEN-034) but no fact says they are entered at the office at registration; no rural share is given, only regional deployment rates (SEN-032); the total of centres is 629 in 2026 and 689 in SEN-054; finance:domestic rests on an unnotified 2026 agency budget (SEN-013) and an unquantified 'substantial public funding' (SEN-056), beside EU finance to June 2026 (SEN-042).
cells.note: The LGEC is past its pilot (SEN-028) and live in the centres, registering births into one national system, but the offices figure is a share equipped, which the ladder places at stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of offices shown as doing the entry, on a share or a count with a denominator.
